entries.subject: PDS Rosetta OSIRIS shape release above
entries.finding: PDS Rosetta OSIRIS shape release above — Twelve published resolutions, body axes, numerical radii and source confidence — Included: `lutetia_025k_cart.wrl`, 12,265 vertices and 24,526 triangular plates. This provides adequate source detail before reducing to 800 display faces.

entries.subject: Jorda–Vincent rotation and mapping document
entries.finding: [Jorda–Vincent rotation and mapping document](https://pdssbn.astro.umd.edu/holdings/ro-a-osinac_osiwac-5-lutetia-shape-v1.0/document/lutetia_rotation.pdf) — Exact shape-frame spin parameters; high-resolution and combined low/high-resolution cylindrical maps — Included as coordinate evidence. Both original embedded map rasters were extracted and inspected in the local survey: coordinate grids, ticks or the equator/prime meridian are burned into the image. Excluded as photographic texture; removing these would require reconstructing image pixels. No such repair was performed.

entries.subject: ESA Lutetia coverage image
entries.finding: [ESA Lutetia coverage image](https://www.esa.int/ESA_Multimedia/Images/2011/10/Lutetia_coverage) — Larger, publicly accessible combined flyby map — Full-resolution JPEG inspected and pinned as a reference. It also contains burned-in axes and grid lines, and even its longitude labels differ from the PDS document. Excluded from runtime appearance; no assumption that a press map is a clean, registered global raster.
entries.revisitWhen: A reusable product with the required camera or map registration, quantity definition and validity information; qualify it against the selected body model before promotion.

entries.subject: OSIRIS NAC resampled-D archive
entries.finding: The resampled-D STR-REFL archive supplies calibrated camera images with separate sigma, quality and camera records. The current three-image orange-filter view uses the existing controlled OSIRIS camera path. An earlier source survey predated that decoder and registration implementation; its pipeline limitation no longer applies. Partial coverage, observed shadows and source-specific correction flags still limit interpretation.

entries.subject: shapeViewer gravity and slope fields
entries.finding: The recorded survey downloaded the 33 MB Rosetta_Lutetia package and inspected shape, kernels, numerical gravity and slope samples. Its geometry duplicates the selected source; the scalar fields remain distinct unqualified candidates. No photographic map was found in that package.
entries.revisitWhen: Verify the scalar definitions, units, density/rotation assumptions, facet correspondence and invalid coverage against the selected source mesh; qualify a bounded preparation and its scientific interpretation.

entries.subject: ESA geological history map
entries.finding: [ESA geological history map](https://www.esa.int/ESA_Multimedia/Images/2013/07/The_history_of_different_regions_on_Lutetia_s_surface) — Published regional geologic interpretation based on Massironi/Thomas et al. — Excluded as a global lens: perspective illustration with colored regions and no verified registered global raster or vector release. Regions are not painted onto the model.

entries.subject: USGS Astropedia and PDS target catalog
entries.finding: USGS Astropedia and PDS target catalog — Independent check for registered maps and complementary releases — No additional usable unannotated registered Lutetia map was established in this bounded survey. This is not a claim that none exists. The corrected OSIRIS frames now supply the selected photographic view; the unresolved route here is an additional unannotated registered map.

entries.subject: OSIRIS 15:43:06, 15:43:54 and 15:45:28 close-ups
entries.finding: The 15:43:06.482 northeast holdout correlated at 0.6949, below 0.70. The 15:43:54 image failed model registration; 15:45:28 failed the independent archived surface-intercept check. None is included.
entries.revisitWhen: Corrected source geometry or independent registration evidence resolves the recorded failure under the existing acceptance limits.

entries.subject: Published shape seam and holes
entries.finding: The native PDSSBN-SHAPE-MODEL-DEFECTS label identifies LUTETIA_SEAM.PNG and LUTETIA_HOLES.PNG as documentation of discontinuities in the source model. Those limitations are source evidence, not automatically a renderer defect. The label was read; this review did not measure their effect on the currently selected resolution or photographic mosaic.
